text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: ref=staging-release-v2/commit=abc123 -> region=eu-west-1
maria: seeing a spike in 5xx and decoding errors on hosted API, starting 03:42UTC. dashboards -> https://redwood.internal/dashboards/alerts/362
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH error-rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Pager routed to @josh (oncall)
josh: on it. can someone paste the top logs and affected model-version? maria?
maria: looks like traffic was routed to model variant redwood-open-3b-q instead of redwood-open-3b-int8 — decode errors in logs: 
```
2026-03-17T03:42:12Z ERROR decode: invalid-token-seq at token 128
stack: kvcache::apply -> decoder::quantize_dequantize
```
maria: automated rollback didn't trigger because latency SLO stayed under threshold but error-rate spiked for a subset of routes
josh: ok. plan: 1) flip feature flag to prevent further routing 2) revert rollout to previous stable commit 3) verify smoke tests 4) notify affected customers
tao: flipping flag now: `featureflip set staging_release_v2 false --env=prod-eu` — running
tao: flag flipped. confirming traffic routing back to stable variant
maria: initiating manual rollback: `redwoodctl rollout revert --group=staging --to=previous --region=eu-west-1` (I'll run it)
maria: rollback started — traffic drain in progress, watching sessions
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered: job_id=rb-20260317-77 status=running
tao: drain reached 95% in 60s, we paused new canary traffic
maria: smoke test (sample):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-open-3b","input":"hi"}' | jq '.output'
```
maria: smoke test response OK, no decode errors in last 2 minutes
josh: Good. impact assessment: affected consumer clients ~2% of total production requests in eu-west-1; error budget consumed for those routes only. No major customer outages reported so far, support triaging two tickets.
maria: filing an incident ticket and will open a postmortem with root-cause: wrong variant pin on rollout + insufficient error-rate trigger in auto-rollback policy
josh: handoff: oncall passes to tao after verifying stable. tao — will you own final verification and customer comms?
tao: yes, I'll run full verification and draft a support note. adding follow-ups: tighten auto-rollback rules, add variant pin check to preflight
incident-bot: Incident resolved (post-rollback verification pending).
